name: io.github.horatiuvlad/oblio-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Oblio.eu accounting — invoices, proformas, delivery notices, payments, e-Factura/SPV and nomenclatures, built on Oblio's official SDK.

environmentVariables.name: OBLIO_API_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Oblio account email (Setari > Date Cont), used as the OAuth client id.

environmentVariables.name: OBLIO_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Oblio API secret (Setari > Date Cont), used as the OAuth client secret.

environmentVariables.name: OBLIO_CIF
environmentVariables.description: Default company CIF (e.g. RO12345678). Optional; can be changed at runtime with set_cif.

environmentVariables.name: OBLIO_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to persist the OAuth access token across restarts. Defaults to in-memory only.
